## What this changes

Describe the user or integration problem and the resulting behavior. Link the issue with `Closes #…` when applicable.

## How it was verified

List automated tests and any manual producer/consumer checks.

## Compatibility

Describe effects on existing websites, agents, editors, manifests, scenes, and assets. Write `No compatibility impact` when none exists.

## Checklist

- [ ] The title follows Conventional Commits (`type(scope): description`).
- [ ] The change is focused and contains no unrelated edits.
- [ ] Tests cover behavioral changes and pass locally.
- [ ] Public behavior and integration changes are documented.
- [ ] A changeset is included for affected published packages, or it is not needed.
- [ ] Protocol changes link to an accepted proposal and update schema, types, validation, fixtures, and docs together.
- [ ] No credentials, private URLs, or sensitive test data are included.
